timepoint_policy.rule: Capture source-defined participant-level emergency contraceptive pill use at follow-up from 6 through 12 months; preserve the precise cohort and cumulative follow-up wording.

primary_analysis_spec.outcome_group: Any emergency contraceptive pill use after advance provision
selection_rules: Select one complete binary record per randomized trial when it compares advance emergency contraceptive pill provision with standard or on-demand access and reports participants with one or more emergency contraceptive pill uses.
Require source-defined 6- to 12-month follow-up, complete group denominators, and a calculator-generated RR.
Do not use target-review forest rows, review totals, article-specific labels, or target pooled effects.
Select at most one eligible effect per independent study for this analysis.
Timepoint eligibility: Capture source-defined participant-level emergency contraceptive pill use at follow-up from 6 through 12 months; preserve the precise cohort and cumulative follow-up wording.
outcome_terms: Any emergency contraceptive pill use after advance provision
